headline: U.S. prepares Iran strikes while Russia escalates drone attacks on Ukraine
subheadline: Trump administration briefed Gulf allies for possible Iran strikes Nov 4, while Russian drones crippled Kyiv’s TEC-6 plant and Dnipro’s substation
lede: Washington signaled a potential offensive against Tehran by briefing Gulf allies for strikes as early as Nov 4, while Qatari mediators pursued marathon talks in Tehran and Doha to unlock a U.S.-Iran deal. In Gaza, Israeli forces eliminated four Hamas operatives, including a Nukhba Force member, and senior commander Ihab Abu Taqiya in Nuseirat, who was involved in holding hostages. Meanwhile, Russian forces launched a coordinated drone assault on Oct 30‑31, hitting Kyiv’s TEC‑6 thermal plant with three Geran‑5 drones and striking Dnipro’s substation and railway station, while dozens of reactive UAVs crossed into northern and central Ukraine.

sections.title: Russian drone campaign escalates across Ukraine
sections.body: Russian forces executed a multi‑axis drone assault overnight 30‑31 October, striking Kyiv’s TEC‑6 thermal power plant with three Geran‑5 drones and causing widespread power and water outages. A double strike on Dnipro damaged an electrical substation and the railway station, creating a large smoke column. Dozens of reactive UAVs were tracked from Sumy through Poltava toward Kyiv and Cherkasy, targeting towns such as Romny, Buryn, Lohvytsia, and Pyriatyn, while a ballistic missile threat was reported from Kursk.

sections.title: Israel–Hamas fighting intensifies amid diplomatic push
sections.body: IDF killed four Hamas operatives in Khan Younis and Rafah, including a Nukhba Force member, and eliminated senior commander Ihab Abu Taqiya in Nuseirat, who was involved in holding hostages. The Israeli army razed homes of two Palestinian gunmen in Hebron after they killed two soldiers. Artillery shelling continued along the Lebanon‑Israel border, with strikes reported in Zoutar Al‑Sharqiyah, Wadi Al‑Salouqi, and Hariss. Meanwhile, the Trump administration briefed Gulf allies for possible strikes on Iran as early as Nov 4, while Qatari mediators held marathon talks in Tehran and Doha to unlock a U.S.‑Iran deal.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The convergence of U.S. strike preparations against Iran, Israeli targeting of Hamas leadership, and persistent cross‑border fire in Lebanon signals a multi‑front escalation trajectory. Russian long‑range drone and missile operations against Ukrainian energy and transport nodes, coupled with tactical gains near Hranove, indicate an intensified campaign designed to degrade Ukrainian logistics and resilience.
